purpose: A governed discovery and identity backbone for a global cross-domain knowledge graph. Registration does not imply unrestricted content copying or live connector activation.
principles: Prefer registries-of-registries and official knowledge graphs before adding duplicate source-specific connectors.
Separate source registration, live connector activation, bulk ingestion, and controlled-access application.
Preserve canonical identifiers, provenance, licenses, rights statements, and temporal validity.
Never treat free web access as permission for bulk copying, commercial reuse, personal profiling, or patient-level exposure.
Do not re-enable sources explicitly removed by governance without a new user directive.
GPTs remains the sole cross-center relay; no center-to-center direct calls.

integration_states.existing-active: Already represented by an existing managed provider or governed source family.
integration_states.backbone-candidate: High-value registry, ontology, federated catalog, or discovery API prioritized for direct bounded activation.
integration_states.catalog-only: Registered for discovery and graph mapping; no new direct runtime connector is asserted.
integration_states.conditional-free: Free or metadata-free only under an account, key, eligibility rule, or limited-use license.
integration_states.application-required: Requires institutional, research, data-use, or manual approval.
integration_states.web-only: Official public web source with no stable verified programmatic contract.
integration_states.deferred: Potentially useful but blocked by endpoint, security, duplication, or governance issues.
